lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Explicit model: planning steps and materials

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice planning steps and materials. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: An adult models planning by taking a different sample household task and breaking it into an ordered sequence of steps, naming the materials each step needs.
safetyNotes: This is a planning task; no physical task execution happens in this lesson.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Was your step-count guess from the warm-up close to your actual plan? What made planning this task easier or harder than you expected?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Step-sequence logic: Steps are in a workable, logical order. | Materials-per-step accuracy: Materials are matched to the specific step that needs them. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Identify one step in the plan that could go wrong and write a specific backup plan for just that step.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice planning steps and materials. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: paper and pencil
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: planning steps and materials worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: An adult models planning by taking a different sample household task and breaking it into an ordered sequence of steps, naming the materials each step needs.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact planning steps and materials decision or action.
Model move 2: Before the model, guess: how many separate steps do you think your chosen contribution will actually take?
Model move 3: Watch your adult model breaking a sample task into ordered steps with materials for each, then ask questions about anything unclear.
Model check: Step-sequence logic: Steps are in a workable, logical order. | Materials-per-step accuracy: Materials are matched to the specific step that needs them.

resources.title: planning steps and materials action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for planning steps and materials.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: planning steps and materials coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: An adult models planning by taking a different sample household task and breaking it into an ordered sequence of steps, naming the materials each step needs.
Coach direction: Before the model, guess: how many separate steps do you think your chosen contribution will actually take?
Learner prompt: State your guess.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: planning steps and materials complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Watch your adult model breaking a sample task into ordered steps with materials for each, then ask questions about anything unclear.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I could restate the sample task's step order back in my own words.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I could name which materials went with which step, not just a general materials list.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I asked at least one question about the modeling before starting my own plan.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: planning steps and materials minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Was your step-count guess from the warm-up close to your actual plan? What made planning this task easier or harder than you expected?
Success checks: Step-sequence logic: Steps are in a workable, logical order. | Materials-per-step accuracy: Materials are matched to the specific step that needs them.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: planning steps and materials supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional planning steps and materials condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Step-sequence logic: Steps are in a workable, logical order. | Materials-per-step accuracy: Materials are matched to the specific step that needs them..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guidedFirstAttempt.setup: An adult models planning by taking a different sample household task and breaking it into an ordered sequence of steps, naming the materials each step needs.
coachMoves: Ask the learner to name the condition.
Point to one model step only.
Give feedback against one observable success check.
guidedFirstAttempt.successCondition: Step-sequence logic: Steps are in a workable, logical order.
guidedFirstAttempt.correctionTurn: Use the fresh condition on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-guided-card: change one constraint, redo only the affected move, and state why the corrected move now meets the success check.

simulationRoute.title: planning steps and materials — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the planning steps and materials task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Was your step-count guess from the warm-up close to your actual plan? What made planning this task easier or harder than you expected?
observableCriteria: Step-sequence logic: Steps are in a workable, logical order.
Materials-per-step accuracy: Materials are matched to the specific step that needs them.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Step-sequence logic: Steps are in a workable, logical order. | Materials-per-step accuracy: Materials are matched to the specific step that needs them.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
